name: Surface-constrained Cursor
aliases: 2D Point Cursor on Volumetric Display Surface
definition: A cursor restricted to moving along the outer surface of the volumetric display, adapting the ray-casting technique used in 3D applications.
summary: The Surface-constrained Cursor restricts a 2D input to a volumetric display's outer surface, differing from the Silk Cursor by treating the boundary as a hard constraint for a single point or ray origin.
